LanguageData.Gun_Galil_SAR_556mm_RWP.label: Galil SAR 5.56mm
LanguageData.Gun_Galil_SAR_556mm_RWP.description: The Galil SAR 5.56mm is a compact and reliable assault rifle, known for its durability and effectiveness in various combat situations. Designed with a shorter barrel for increased maneuverability, it offers a balance between power and accuracy, making it ideal for mid-range engagements. With a rapid rate of fire and modest recoil, this weapon is favored by those who value versatility in the heat of battle.
